question_or_proposition: For terms set forth in Parts I–IV, does the permit's separate listing of 'effluent limitations,' 'monitoring requirements,' and 'other conditions' establish which category governs enforceable numeric discharge limits for exceedance comparison, which governs applicable monitoring duties, and which governs conditions under which monitoring or numeric compliance comparison is not required?
required_context: Parts I–IV of farmington/final_permit.pdf showing how provisions are classified as effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, or other conditions
Any provisions whose numeric limits, monitoring duties, or conditional non-applicability rules cross or blur these categories
notes: The nominated span expressly separates effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other conditions when identifying operative Parts I–IV terms. Purpose A requires distinguishing enforceable numeric limits from report-only monitoring; Purpose B requires identifying applicable monitoring requirements; Purpose C requires distinguishing conditional non-requirements and other documented no-data states from missing required evidence.
